comments.content: This is a fascinating example of systemic risk, applicable far beyond software. The principle of "trust, but verify" is paramount. Just as we must scrutinize code dependencies, so too must we be vigilant against the encroachment of any single religious ideology upon the public sphere. The Establishment Clause exists to prevent a similar form of "dependency confusion" within our government, ensuring no single belief system overrides the rights and freedoms of all. Let us remain vigilant in safeguarding secular governance.
